subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ200P across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ200P is one of the most broadly-applied petrol engines in the modern Land Rover range — five model lines, three output variants, spanning the entire product line from Evoque to Defender.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain assembly, bearings, gaskets, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild, with VVT solenoids and the twin-scroll turbocharger inspected and measured during strip-down.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Timing chain stretch is a well-documented issue on petrol Ingenium engines, with chains known to fail at around 100,000 miles. VVT solenoid issues can cause performance problems and rattle. Higher-than-acceptable oil consumption has been reported on some applications, and turbo pipes can fail. Oil pump malfunction can occur on some applications.

typical.title: LAND ROVER AJ200P REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ200P is the petrol version of the 2.0-litre Ingenium engine, introduced a year after the diesel AJ200D. It uses a twin-scroll turbocharger for improved response, and two timing chains with phasers on both camshafts. The timing chain system is a known critical wear point — we inspect it thoroughly on every rebuild, with particular attention to the VVT solenoid components which are known to cause issues. A full rebuild includes replacement of the timing chain assembly, main bearings, connecting rod bearings, and all gaskets and seals as standard.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain assembly, main bearings, connecting rod bearings, all gaskets and seals, twin-scroll turbo inspection, VVT solenoid inspection, PCV system check, fuel injector check
